title: Extract Day of Week from Order Date
description:
Analyse which day of the week orders are placed on. Use `EXTRACT(DOW FROM date)` to retrieve the numeric day-of-week (0 = Sunday, 1 = Monday … 6 = Saturday).

**Table: orders** — `id`, `customer_id`, `order_date`, `amount`

Return `id`, `order_date`, and `EXTRACT(DOW FROM order_date)` aliased as `day_of_week`. Order by `id`.
solution_sql: SELECT id, order_date, EXTRACT(DOW FROM order_date) AS day_of_week FROM orders ORDER BY id

test_cases.description: All 7 orders returned with numeric day-of-week (0=Sun through 6=Sat)

hints: EXTRACT(DOW FROM date_col) returns an integer 0–6 where 0 is Sunday.
DuckDB uses DOW (day of week) not WEEKDAY as the field name inside EXTRACT.
explanation: EXTRACT(DOW FROM order_date) pulls the day-of-week component from each date. The data spans 2026-09-27 (Sunday, DOW=0) through 2026-10-03 (Saturday, DOW=6), so the result cycles cleanly through all seven values.
